description.en: Comprehensive shadcn/ui registry template with docs, landing page, and AI agent support.
description.zh: 集成了官方文档、落地页与 AI Agent 支持的一站式 shadcn 注册表脚手架。

content.en: startercn is an all-in-one starter template for developers wanting to launch their own custom shadcn/ui registry. Built with Next.js, Fumadocs, and Tailwind, it comes equipped with automatic component schema generation, live playground previews, and full LLM agent discovery compatibility.
content.zh: startercn 是一套专为开发者创建并发布自主 shadcn/ui Registry 打造的一站式工程脚手架。基于 Next.js、Fumadocs 与 Tailwind 构建，自带完整的元数据自动生成脚本、代码在线沙盒预览以及面向 LLM 智能体的上下文索引能力。
